# Daemon boundary inventory

This inventory covers every declared daemon-only operation. Core-backed HTTP operations use `ContractRoutes.h` and `ContractJson.h`; their implementation remains in core. Runtime authentication and connection ownership remain outside generated dispatch.

Current dispositions: 1 complete, 43 partially generated AI boundaries, 23 remaining handwritten boundaries.

## Next bounded migrations for everyday Desktop use

1. Generate the project checkpoint/change-stream boundary (`get_event_cursor`, `stream_changes`) when changing remote card refresh. Desktop's `services/presence_stream.vala` consumes `/events`; preserve replay/cursor and named-event semantics.
2. Review health/bye lifecycle boundaries when changing Desktop startup, failure handling or shutdown. Current consumers are `services/api_client/health.vala` and `services/presence_stream.vala`.
3. Finish location list/preference/delete-binding boundaries when changing the storage UI, reusing the proven record codecs. `services/api_client/resources.vala` consumes the location workflow; provider probes and OAuth stay in runtime services. Attachment import/download follows when needed.

Card create/read/update/list/trash/move/restore and project pull/push/sync already use the generated core boundary. Desktop's full-sync behavior remains separate application/runtime work. AI, catalogs, documentation and unrelated domains remain under #390.
